title: Farm animals are silent: petting/feeding plays no species voice (sheep sfx exists but is never used; no cow/chicken/goat/duck/llama/rooster voices)
repro: Farm pen: tap any animal (with or without hay). Only 'eat' plays when hay is fed; plain pet = no sound. grep shows sfx 'sheep' (audio/sfx/sheep.wav) is referenced nowhere.
fix: In game_map.gd 'pet_animal' branch play a species cue keyed on a.kind prefix (cow->moo, chicken/hen->cluck, chick->peep, duck->quack, goat->bleat, sheep/llama->sheep, pig->oink, rooster->crow) via Music.sfx(voice, 'pickup'), pitched up for babies; also a soft cue on produce pop. Import missing CC0 animal takes.
audio_needed: sfx moo, cluck, peep, quack, goat_bleat, llama, oink (2-3 takes each, CC0) ; sheep exists

title: ACE cues crop_ready and j_morning were made but are never played
repro: audio/sfx/ACE.txt lists crop_ready and j_morning; grep scripts: no call site. Waking up plays nothing after the fade; ripe crops never chime.
fix: house.gd after fade_in (and clinic wake): sfx('j_morning') before the SleepReport lines (skip on pass-out nights maybe); play 'crop_ready' once when the morning report has ripe>0 or on entering the farm the first time a day with ripe crops.

title: Reeling in too soon plays 'nope' AND 'fish_escape' with two contradictory toasts
repro: Cast, tap USE before the !!!: toast 'Too soon!' + nope, then the loop breaks with caught=false and the else branch toasts 'It got away.' + fish_escape.
fix: Track a too_soon flag; on too-soon skip the fish_escape/It got away branch (or play only one cue).

title: Pet cues: petting is silent, cats bark/whimper like dogs, sniff-alert and dig are silent; meow/purr sfx exist unused
repro: Tap the pup > 'Pet Pup': heart emote + play anim, no sound. Choose a cat look (animals/cat_*, cat2_*): in fights it plays 'bark', when downed 'whimper'. Ore/forage sniff (pet.gd ~346) plays the bark anim with no sound; _dig and 'dug up a X!' have no cue. grep: 'meow','purr' never played (audio/sfx/meow*.ogg, purr.ogg exist).
fix: Add Pet.voice(kind) helper: cats -> meow/purr (pet), dogs -> bark/whimper. game_map _pup_menu 'pet': sfx(purr for cats, bark softly/'happy' for dogs). pet.gd sniff alert: sfx(voice bark). _dig: sfx('dig') at start, 'pickup' on find. _bite/_knock_down use the voice helper.
audio_needed: optional: dog happy pant/yip and cat hiss/mrrp for fight; meow/purr already exist

title: Morning rooster is a synthetic saw-wave sweep placeholder (spot_rooster.wav), the only farm-animal ambience
repro: audio/amb has only spot_rooster.wav (generated by tools/make_ambience.py line 231 from saw sweeps), no .ogg; plays once each farm morning. No other barn/pen spot sounds (cow, hens, sheep) on the farm map even when animals are owned.
fix: Import a CC0 rooster crow (spot_rooster.ogg wins over .wav); add pen spot sounds to Ambience for the farm when run.animals has that species (low rate, daytime, near the pen).
audio_needed: spot_rooster (CC0 crow, 1-2 takes); spot_hens, spot_cow, spot_sheep low-level pen ambience

title: CraftScreen.station_sound misses most station ids: 15 of 24 stations fall back to the generic 'tools' clatter (cauldron, furnace, campfire, kiln, soda, implant/Chrome Clinic, armory, mill, press...)
repro: Keys of data/recipes.json vs the substring table at craft_screen.gd:366: mill, furnace, tannery, press, kiln, cauldron, resonator, garage, rocket, armory, soda, shaper, litter, campfire, implant all -> 'tools'. 'cauldron' is not matched by brew/alchem/potion; the Chrome Clinic id is 'implant' so the 'chrome'->servo pair never fires. sfx 'cooking' (exists, ACE/CC0) is never used.
fix: Replace the substring table with an explicit id map: kitchen/campfire->cooking (fallback pot), cauldron/soda->bubble, furnace/kiln->anvil or a fire whoosh, implant->servo, armory->reload, mill/press/garage->tools/drill, rocket->power_up, resonator->spell, shaper/tannery/litter->cloth/hammer. Keep 'tools' as last resort; add a test asserting every recipes.json station maps to an existing sfx other than 'tools' unless listed.

title: Scythe and hand-pulling weeds/tall grass play 'chop' (axe-on-wood) instead of a grass swish/rustle
repro: Hold scythe, cut weeds/tall grass on farm or meadow (game_map.gd 'weeds' branch ~609): sfx('chop'). Same for pulling a weed by hand. Wood thunk on grass. Verified at runtime with tools/probe_c6_10_farm.gd (logging Music subclass): weeds by hand -> ['chop']; pickaxe rock kill -> ['pick','crate_break']; GameState.consume('strawberry_wine') -> {energy: 30}.
fix: Scythe/blade: sfx('swing') + a soft 'step_leaves'/'twig' rustle (or a new 'scythe' cue); by hand: 'step_leaves' or 'pickup'. scythe_sweep may add one extra rustle for the swath.
audio_needed: optional sfx scythe (grass swish, 2-3 takes, CC0)

title: Walking through farm tall grass plays step_grass on the SFX voices at full sfx level (~14 dB louder than footsteps, with pitch drift) on top of the normal footstep
repro: farm.gd ~848: Music.sfx('step_grass', 'step') each new walkable-grass cell. sfx() plays at -4 dB; Music.step() plays step_grass at STEP_DB -14 + -4 = -18 dB. The rustle is loud and steals sfx voices; fallback 'step' does not exist.
fix: Add Music.rustle() (or step(ground, extra_db)) on its own quiet voice, e.g. step_leaves at about -16 dB, and drop the bogus 'step' fallback.

title: Swinging a farm tool at nothing (hoe/axe/pickaxe/scythe/can) is silent; tool anims never carry a whoosh
repro: player.gd ~1104: held farm tool, empty target -> play_tool(act) only; play_tool has no sfx. Sword at air plays 'swing' (game_map ~1907), tools do not.
fix: In that branch play a light sfx('swing') (axe/pickaxe/scythe/hoe) or a dribble for the can ('water' at -8 dB); keep it rate-limited by the existing repeat cooldown.

title: chest_open_2 is a lock click (80-CC0-RPG lock_01) and ~8 dB quieter than chest_open: every other chest open plays a quiet 'click' instead of a lid creak; no close cue at all
repro: audio/CC0_USED.json chest_open = [wooded_box_open.ogg, lock_01.ogg]; SOFTEN_LOG after-rms chest_open -18.0 vs chest_open_2 -25.8. Music.sfx picks a random take, so half the openings are the click. ChestScreen.close() plays nothing (menu_close / door_close exist).
fix: Replace chest_open_2 with a second wooden-lid take (or drop it) and level to within 2 dB; add a 'chest_close' cue (CC0 box close) played in ChestScreen.close() (fallback menu_close). Also play chest_open softly on 'Stack to chests' when res[0] > 0 (game_menu._stack_nearby) and a 'nope' with the bag-overflow toast (hud.gd overflow_note).

title: Take levels drift inside farm cues: harvest_3 ~6 dB under harvest, timber_2 is a 0.48 s wood drop vs a 2.3 s tree fall
repro: SOFTEN_LOG after-rms: harvest -17.2, harvest_2 -18.7, harvest_3 -23.3. timber.ogg dur 2.29 s (chop-tree-fall) vs timber_2.ogg 0.48 s (wood_falling_01, a plank drop): felling a tree randomly gets a plank clatter. Random take pick (Music._load_sfx) makes the same action jump in loudness/character.
fix: sfx_soften: add a per-name take-matching pass (level every _2/_3 to the base take's rms within ±1.5 dB). Replace timber_2 with another tree-fall/creak-and-crash take (or remove it).

title: Breaking a rock with the pickaxe plays 'crate_break' (wooden crate splinter) instead of the existing 'rock_break'
repro: Farm/meadow: pickaxe a rock to 0 hp -> GameMap.break_rock (game_map.gd ~998) sfx('crate_break'); CC0_USED crate_break = wood_crack/wood_break files. Same in mine.gd ~989 for mine rocks. audio/sfx/rock_break*.ogg (breaking-rock, stones) is only used by community_farm and enemy.gd. Verified at runtime with tools/probe_c6_10_farm.gd (logging Music subclass): weeds by hand -> ['chop']; pickaxe rock kill -> ['pick','crate_break']; GameState.consume('strawberry_wine') -> {energy: 30}.
fix: break_rock and mine.gd rock kill: sfx('rock_break', 'thud'). Keep crate_break for crates (mine.gd ~2222).

title: Planting and harvesting use the same dry-leaf rustle family; harvest has no reward 'pluck/pop', silver-star harvest is silent
repro: CC0_USED: plant = rustle01-03, harvest = rustle10/12/15 (same qubodup dry-leaves pack). farm.gd ~1281 harvest plays only that rustle (+pickup fallback never used). Gold star plays 'crit'; silver star (~1272) plays nothing.
fix: Harvest: layer the rustle with a soft 'pop'/'pickup' (sfx('pickup') 0.1 s later) or import a CC0 vegetable pluck; plant: soil pat ('dig' quiet) rather than a dry-leaf rustle. Silver star: sfx('sparkle').
audio_needed: optional harvest_pluck (CC0 pluck/pull from soil, 2-3 takes)

title: Pass-out nights skip the morning cues: kept report shows with no coin/built cue; collapsing from exhaustion plays the cozy 'sleep' jingle
repro: house._sleep plays cash/coin when earned>0 and craft_done when something was built. Pass out (2am or energy 0): game_map.player_down plays 'sleep' (same as going to bed) then house.after_ready shows SleepReport.take_kept() lines with no cues (and none in the clinic path).
fix: Factor a SleepReport.cues(report) helper called from both house._sleep and the kept-report path (house.after_ready + clinic note). For reason tired/late use a heavier cue (e.g. 'thud' soft + 'snore'), keep 'sleep' for the bed.

title: Farm buildings' own actions are silent: coop incubator (egg in, 'The hens cluck at you' toast), keg loading, resonator refine
repro: farm.gd _coop (~1661): toast 'The hens cluck at you.' and egg into incubator, no sfx. _keg (~1686): loading produce plays nothing (collect gets give()->pickup). _resonator (~1711): only give()->pickup, no hum/zap for the refine. Chick hatching (farm.gd ~2017) is never announced with a cue.
fix: _coop: sfx('cluck' if present else 'critter') on the toast; egg in -> sfx('pop'). _keg load: sfx('bubble') (or 'pot'). _resonator: sfx('spell', 'sparkle') with the pawring fx. Hatch day: a 'peep' or 'j_birthday'-style chirp when the farm loads with a newly hatched chick.

title: door_close takes (3 files) are never played: leaving the house/barn plays the same door-open creak as entering
repro: grep door_close in scripts: no hits. GameMap.go_to (~2845) plays sfx('door') for any house/interior/mine transition in either direction.
fix: In go_to: if leaving an interior/house (scene_id() in house/interior/mine and target is outdoors) play 'door_close' (fallback 'door'), else 'door'. Or play door on leave + door_close after the fade-in on arrival outdoors.

title: Swimming strokes play the full-level 'splash' every 0.7 s on the SFX voices (~14 dB over footsteps, near-continuous since takes are 0.6-1.0 s)
repro: Swim in the farm river/pond: player.gd ~845 Music.sfx('splash') each 0.7 s (sfx base -4 dB) while land steps go through Music.step at ~-15..-18 dB. Entering water also uses fallback 'bite' (the fishing bite cue) at ~1234.
fix: Route swim strokes through Music.step('water') or a dedicated quiet 'swim' cue (STEP voice, ~-12 dB) and keep the loud splash only for entering water; change the entry fallback from 'bite' to 'step_water'.
audio_needed: optional swim stroke takes (CC0, soft paddle)

title: Fishing has no bobber plop when the line lands and the catch has no water splash cue (fx only)
repro: game_map.gd ~4285: 'cast' swish plays at once; the bobber appears with no landing sound. On reel, fx reel_splash/fish_jump show but only 'reel' (ratchet) plays.
fix: _later(0.35) sfx('step_water' or 'splash' at low level) for the plop; on a catch add sfx('splash') alongside 'reel'.

title: Seed 'won't take in this soil' refusal is silent (other farm refusals play 'nope'; 'Too tired.' already gets nope via GameState.spend_for)
repro: Hold a seed whose crop id isn't in crops.json and tap tilled soil: farm.gd ~1204 toast only, no cue. Off-season seed (~1213) plays 'nope'.
fix: Add Music.sfx('nope') to the won't-take toast.

title: Placing/picking up sprinklers, scarecrows and chests and storing hay in the silo are silent
repro: farm.gd _place_item (~2147): poof fx + toast, no sfx. pickup_placed (~1610): give() pickup only. _silo store (~1650): toast only; 'silo is full' / 'empty' toasts silent.
fix: _place_item: sfx('thud') soft (wood) or 'drop'; silo store: sfx('cloth' or 'step_leaves') rustle; full/empty: 'nope'.

title: 'Station finished' toast (Crafting.newly_done) and the midnight/1:30 bedtime notes are silent
repro: Start a workshop job, walk away: when done, game_map.gd ~2791 toasts the note with no cue, so it's easy to miss on a phone. Faint.bedtime_note toasts at midnight/1:30 (~2795) also silent.
fix: After the newly_done loop: if any note, Music.sfx('crop_ready', 'sparkle') once (the unused ACE cue fits). Bedtime note: a soft clock/bell cue (e.g. 'shop_bell' low, or a new 'clock_chime').

title: Keg alcohol can be drunk: strawberry_wine, corn_ale, harvest_ale, flower_mead carry 'energy' so holding one and tapping USE 'eats' it (content rule: real wine is a trade good, never drunk)
repro: data/items.json: strawberry_wine {type crop, energy 30}, corn_ale {crop, energy 30}, harvest_ale {food, energy 30}, flower_mead {food, energy 40} (keg outputs from GameState.keg_brew ~1867-1883). Hold one, USE at nothing -> game_map.gd ~2165 consume -> toast 'Ate Strawberry Wine.' + eat crunch; also eatable from the Items tab (game_menu._eat). wine/fruit_wine/fine_wine are already 'gift' with no energy. Verified at runtime with tools/probe_c6_10_farm.gd (logging Music subclass): weeds by hand -> ['chop']; pickaxe rock kill -> ['pick','crate_break']; GameState.consume('strawberry_wine') -> {energy: 30}.
fix: Drop energy from those four (make them type 'gift'/'goods' like fruit_wine) or add a no_eat flag checked in game_map consume + game_menu._eat; keep them sellable/giftable. (cider/root_beer: decide which are non-alcoholic; root_beer is fine.)

title: Drinks and potions play the 'eat' crunch (apple bite) instead of the existing 'drink' cue
repro: Hold milk/coffee/tea/juice/potion/energy_tea and USE (game_map.gd ~2174) or eat from the Items tab (game_menu.gd ~1337): sfx('eat') -> crunch takes (CC0 crunch.1/3, apple_bite). audio/sfx/drink*.ogg (3 takes) is only used by commons.gd. Player also plays the 'eat' tool anim.
fix: Helper GameState.is_drink(id) (type drink/potion/tonic, or id contains milk/tea/coffee/juice/soda/cocoa/smoothie/tonic/elixir/draught/potion/brew) -> sfx('drink','eat'); use in both call sites and the pet feed path.

title: Pet commands, recall, revive and going home are silent (no whistle, no answering bark)
repro: pet.gd set_mode (~189 toast 'Pup: heel.'), recall (~217 'came running' / 'is here'), revive_with (~277 'back on its feet!'), _go_home (~294): toasts and emotes only.
fix: set_mode/recall: a short whistle (new 'whistle' cue, fallback 'ui_tap') then the pet voice (bark/meow per c6_10-04); revive: voice + 'heal'; go home: 'whimper' soft (cats: meow).

title: Riding the horse plays human footsteps; mount/dismount silent ('horse' sfx = a CC0 trot loop, used only by MegaTravel)
repro: Mount the farm horse (game_map 'horse' thing -> player.mount): player.gd ~846 steps check only vehicle == "", so while mounted Music.step(ground) plays boot steps at the faster stride. mount() (~117) / dismount() (~127) play nothing. audio/sfx/horse.ogg (horse-trotting/Trot.ogg) exists.
fix: In the step block: if mounted -> a hoof cue on the step voice (slice 'horse' trot into 2-3 single hoof takes, e.g. step_hoof, at STEP_DB) with a slower 0.3 s cadence; mount: whinny/snort cue (or 'horse' at -6 dB), dismount: soft 'thud'.
audio_needed: horse whinny/snort (CC0), hoof single hits (slice from the existing trot)
